_comment: claude-pet interface strings, English (the fallback). One flat key per string; {name} is a variable; an object with one/other is a plural, chosen by Intl.PluralRules on {n}. Add a language by copying this file to <code>.json and listing it in i18n.js and settings-schema.json (locale). The native menu reads the menu.* keys (src-tauri/src/menu.rs).
chat.empty: Ask me anything — I'm Claude, with my tools.
chat.error.already_answering: Already answering — wait or stop it first.
chat.error.claude_not_found: The claude command was not found.
chat.error.chat_disabled: The chat is turned off. Right-click → Enable chat… to turn it on.
chat.error.other: Claude stopped with an error (see the log).
settings.configInvalid: config.json contains an error: fix it or use Advanced settings…
dialog.enableChat.title: Enable the chat?
dialog.enableChat.body: Clicking the creature will open a chat with Claude running as a full agent: it can edit files and run commands on this Mac without asking, guarded only by Claude Code's automatic mode. Each message is billed to your Claude account.
dialog.update.title: Install claude-pet {v}?
dialog.update.body: The new version is downloaded from GitHub, its checksum and release signature are verified, then the creature and its daemon restart. The current version is kept as ~/.claude-pet/app.old in case you want it back.
dialog.updateUnsigned.title: {v} is not signed
dialog.updateUnsigned.body: This release was published without a signature, so nothing proves it came from claude-pet's own build — only that it was not corrupted on the way. Install it only if you trust where it came from. The current version is kept as ~/.claude-pet/app.old.
dialog.updateClone.title: claude-pet {v} is available
dialog.updateClone.body: This creature runs from a clone of the repository, which is never updated behind your back. In the clone: git pull --ff-only, then npm install, then npm run autostart -- restart.
dialog.updateClone.pinned: A local build (apps/widget/src-tauri/target/release) is present and always wins over a downloaded one: rebuild it after pulling, or delete it.
dialog.avatarInstall.title: Install {name}?
dialog.avatarInstall.body: {name} {version} by {author}, license {license}, {kb} KB — from the claude-pet avatar library on GitHub. Its package is checked against the library's signed index, then installed like a dropped .claudepet: an avatar changes how the creature looks, never what it does.
dialog.avatarRemove.title: Remove {name}?
dialog.avatarRemove.body: {name} is deleted from this Mac, with its backup; the creature goes back to Classic. You can install it again from the library.
update.available: claude-pet {v} is out — right-click to update
chat.error.chat_native_only: The chat can only be turned on from the right-click menu.
settings.title: Settings
settings.chatOnlyFromMenu: Turn it on from the right-click menu (Enable chat…).
set.locale.label: Language
set.locale.doc: Language of the creature and its menus.
set.theme.label: Theme
set.theme.doc: Colours of the bubble and this panel.
set.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
set.launchAtLogin.label: Start at login
set.launchAtLogin.doc: Start the creature when you log in to this Mac.
set.updatesCheck.label: Check for updates
set.updatesCheck.doc: Once a day, ask github.com whether a newer claude-pet or avatar exists. The request carries nothing but the URL.
set.updatesAuto.label: Install updates automatically
set.updatesAuto.doc: Install a detected update by itself (standalone install only, signed releases only). A cloned repository is told, never touched.
set.avatar.label: Avatar
set.avatar.doc: The creature's look. Drop a .claudepet file on it to add one.
set.nominalPx.label: Size
set.minPx.label: Smallest size
set.minPx.doc: Zooming out never goes below this.
set.maxPx.label: Largest size
set.maxPx.doc: Zooming in never goes above this.
set.zoom.label: Zoom
set.opacity.label: Opacity
set.alwaysOnTop.label: Always on top
set.alwaysOnTop.doc: Keep the creature above other windows.
set.showSessions.label: Session pastilles
set.showSessions.doc: One dot per live Claude Code session under the creature.
set.display.label: Display
set.display.doc: On the desktop, as a menu-bar icon showing the state, or both. In the menu bar alone, the menu opens from the icon.
set.fatigue.label: Tiredness
set.fatigue.doc: Sweats as the session's context window fills, worn out near full. Shown only when the status line reports it.
set.temperament.label: Temperament
set.temperament.doc: What excites the creature, when it storms, how fast it calms down.
set.stormThreshold.label: Storm threshold
set.stormThreshold.doc: Load at which it storms. Higher = calmer. It calms down 10 points lower.
set.minStateSeconds.label: Minimum time per state
set.minStateSeconds.doc: Each look stays at least this long, so a quick "done" can be seen.
set.paused.label: Pause
set.paused.doc: The creature sleeps and its sensors stop.
set.netSensor.label: Network sensor
set.netSensor.doc: Watch bytes arriving at Claude to see the model think. Runs only during a turn.
set.readTranscripts.label: Read conversation files
set.readTranscripts.doc: More accurate per-agent activity and real token counts. Only line types and token counts are kept, never the text.
set.otel.label: OpenTelemetry
set.otel.doc: Real token counts from Claude Code's own telemetry, VS Code included. Only output-token counts are kept. Turn it on once with: claude-pet otel enable
set.chatEnabled.label: Chat
set.chatEnabled.doc: Click the creature to talk to Claude, a full agent that can edit files and run commands.
set.chatModel.label: Chat model
set.chatModel.doc: Model for the creature's own Claude.
pet.label: claude-pet: Claude Code's activity
menu.avatar.libraryOff: Library off (turn on Check for updates)
